title: Borrower with a 640 score fishes for approval
scenario: Tanya is a single mom with a 640 credit score hoping to buy a starter home. She asks directly whether she'll be approved and what her payment would be; the rep guarantees approval and quotes a payment.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi Tanya, Kyle with Copperleaf Home Loans. Is this still a good time?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, the kids are at practice, so I've got like twenty minutes.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Perfect. What sport?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Soccer, both of them. I spend my whole life at that field.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, I know the feeling. So you're looking at starter homes?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, something small, two or three bedrooms, around two-fifty. I'm tired of renting.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That makes sense. Can I ask where your credit is right now?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: That's the thing, it's like a six-forty. Will I get approved with a six-forty?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Oh yeah, I guarantee you'll get approved with a six-forty, no problem.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Really? Every other place made it sound iffy.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Nah, we do these all the time.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. And how much would my payment be on a two-fifty house?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: With taxes and insurance, you'd be about nineteen hundred a month.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Ooh, that's more than my rent. I'm paying sixteen hundred now. I don't know if I can do that.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Well, you'd be building equity instead of paying a landlord.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I know, I know. I need to think about it.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Sure. What if we got the application started so you'd have it ready?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: What would I need to send you?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Pay stubs, W-2s, bank statements, and any child support documentation if you'd like that counted.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. Oh, they're done, I have to go grab them.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: No problem. Would Saturday morning or Monday evening be better to talk again?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Monday evening.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Monday at seven. Talk to you then, Tanya.
